I have a small favor to ask.
strings.요즘 이런저런 일로 정신이 없다 보니 단원들에게 신경을 많이 못 쓴 것: I've been so busy lately that I haven't paid enough attention to the company. Some of them are decent enough, but...
I'll need cat food to find the cat.
Can't do anything without earning money. Ugh...
Hehe. This time, I'll create the ultimate miracle medicine.
strings.어딜 봐서 괜찮아 보인다는 거죠?: Which part of that looks decent?
strings.그런 편견 가득한 시선으로 보니까 그런 거야. 그래서 말인데, 저 단원들: That's because you're looking at them with prejudice. Anyway, could you hear Jubil out? Not those lot.
I listened, but it wasn't something I could solve.
strings.그 와중에 네가 나타나서 다행이야. 나보단 경험도 많고, 힘도 세고, 아: So I'm glad you're here. You have more experience, more strength, and more contacts than me. You might help her...
If it's just listening, I can do that.
strings.(저 웃음, 뭔가 있는 것 같은데…. 그래도 별일 아니겠지….): (That laugh sounds suspicious... Still, it can't be anything serious...)
strings.정신없어서 감사하단 말도 못 드렸네요. 안 그러면 같이 언데드가 됐을지도: I've been so busy I never thanked you. We might have become undead together otherwise...
It's all right. Don't worry about it.
strings.그런데, 저한테 무슨 용무라도 있나요?: Did you need something from me?
Parmila suggested I listen to what you have to say.
strings.저라도 괜찮다면 이야기해주시겠어요?: If you don't mind telling me...?
Then I will. I think you might be able to help, adventurer.
strings.후훗, 알았어요. 요즘 미르간디아에 특이한 옷을 입은 사람들이 돌아다녀서: Hehe, fair enough. Lately, people in unusual clothes have been roaming Mirgandia. I asked, and they're called 'Jewel Stars.'
strings.보석에 마력을 담아 콰쾅하고 부수면서 몬스터를 공격하고…. 좀 신기했어요: They put mana into gems, smash them with a bang, and attack monsters... Quite fascinating.
Oh, right. You come from a merchant family.
Yes, gem merchants. Completely bankrupt now, unfortunately.
strings.많이 벌어서 빨리 용병단 생활을 정리하고 싶어요. 여기서 모으는 돈이라고: I want to earn enough to leave mercenary life behind. All I save here is pocket change. I need something solid.
strings.그런 제 앞에 쥬얼스타가 나타난 거죠. 쥬얼 스타가 많은 루맨에 대량의: Then Jewel Stars appeared. Supplying gems in bulk to Lumen, where so many live, could be a huge business!
I, Jubil, daughter of a gem merchant, won't let this chance pass.
strings.제가 아는 루트가 있어서 그들에게 필요한 보석을 구할 수 있거든요. 그래: I know suppliers who can obtain the gems they need. That's why I'd like a firm favor.
strings.그러니까 루맨에 그걸 가져다 팔고 싶은데, 아는 사람이 없어서 저한테 중: So you want to sell gems in Lumen, but don't know anyone. You'd like me to make an introduction.
strings.역시 척하면 척, 이야기가 빨라서 좋네요. 모험가님이라면 아는 분이 있을: Exactly. I love how quickly you understand. I thought you might know someone.
strings.알고 있기는 해요. 그럼 가서 이야기라도 해드릴까요? 어차피 루맨에는 가: I do. Shall I at least ask? I need to visit Lumen anyway... But don't expect too much.
strings.저희 아버지 실란의 이름을 걸고 이번엔 진짜 잘 될 것 같아요. 그리고: On my father Silan's name, I feel this will work out. And I know I can do it well.
strings.잘 되면 진짜 좋은 걸 드릴게요. 지분이라도…?: If it succeeds, I'll give you something really good. A share, perhaps...?
All right. Share some with me later.
Thank you. I'm counting on you.
strings.(흐음…. 그러면 아스마에게 가볼까? 아스마라면 보석에 관한 이야기를 들: (Hmm... Should I ask Asma? Would she hear me out about gems...?)
Hello, adventurer. Oh, you seem to have something to say...
Hmm... Someone asked me a favor. Let me explain.
I'm afraid this isn't my area. I can't give you a definite answer.
Oh, all right. Nothing to be done.
strings.그래도 많은 보석이 필요하긴 해요. 보석을 이용하는 마법사나 쥬얼스타 같: Still, we do need many gems. There's demand from mages who use them and from Jewel Stars...
strings.저희가 계속 설치해야 할 결계의 규모도 더 커지고 있고…. 아, 그라면: And the barriers we must keep erecting are growing larger... Ah, perhaps he could give a firmer answer than I can.
A stubborn man who thinks of nothing but research.
strings.(순간, 아스마의 얼굴이 굳어진다. 처음 보는 표정이다.): (Asma's face suddenly hardens into an expression you've never seen.)
strings.네. 학파 임원들과도 친분이 있으니 한 번 가서 말해보시는 건 어떨까요?: Yes. He knows the school's officers as well. Why not ask him?
strings.가시기 전에 학파 임원들이 그에게 가져다 달란 물건이 있는데, 대신 구해: Before you leave, the school's officers wanted something brought to him. Could you fetch it and take it along? ♬
strings.(왠지 해주지 않으면 크게 한 번 혼날 것 같은 기분이 드는데….): (I feel like I'll get a serious scolding if I refuse...)
I'll take that as a yes.
Sigh. All right. I'll handle it on the way.
strings.정령들이 사는 공간에서 '정령의 조각'이라는 물건을 구해서 가져다 주시면: Find a 'Spirit Fragment' in the realm where spirits live and bring it to him.
Thank you. I hope things turn out well.
strings.(으, 무서워. 다음부터는 펄스에 관한 이야기가 나오지 않게 해야겠네.): (Scary... I'd better avoid bringing up Pulse next time.)
strings.사람이 왔는데, 설마 인기척도 못 느끼는 건가?: Someone's standing right here. Does he really not notice?
I've brought something you need. And something to discuss.
strings.물건을 가져다주신 건 감사합니다. 그런데 그 외에 이야기에는 흥미가 없습: Thank you for the item. But I'm not interested in anything else.
Asma said I absolutely had to discuss it with you.
No helping it, then. If Asma said so, I'll listen.
strings.(오스큐라스 용병 임시 주둔지에서 이곳까지 오게 된 이유를 설명한다.): (You explain what brought you here from the Oscuras Mercenary Outpost.)
strings.무슨 내용인지 이해했습니다. 다만, 바로 답을 드릴 수는 없을 것 같군요: I understand. But I can't answer immediately.
strings.밀린 연구도 있고, 그런 일이라면 선배들과 따로 연락해야 해서…. 마침,: I have research waiting, and I'd need to contact my seniors about that... As it happens, I'm short of materials.
What do you need? I'll fetch it.
A <Pearl of Darkness>. Not an easy item to obtain...
I suspect I won't finish this without helping somehow. I'll be right back.
Regarding your request, my senior is sending someone with an answer.
strings.(펄스와 비슷한 옷을 입은 사람이 다가와 이런저런 이야기를 하기 시작한다: (Someone dressed similarly to Pulse approaches and begins speaking. As he listens, Pulse's expression gradually hardens.)
strings.최근 저희 학파에 보석이 대량으로 들어왔다고 합니다. 어느 곳하고 거래를: Our school recently received a large shipment of gems. I don't know who the supplier is, but the quality seems quite good.
strings.게다가 급하지 않아서 당장 다른 곳과는 거래하지 않을 예정이라고 하는군요: And since there's no urgency, they don't intend to trade with anyone else for now.
My regrets. Now, if you'll excuse me...
strings.펄스 님께 부탁드릴 일이 있어서 왔는데, 분위기가 심각하네요. 혹시 무슨: I came to ask Pulse a favor, but things look rather serious. Is something wrong?
strings.(비올렛에게 현재 상황을 간단하게 설명한다.): (You briefly explain the situation to Violet.)
strings.괜찮으시다면 모험가님, 제가 있는 쪽으로 오셔서 다시 이야기할 수 있을까: Adventurer, could you come over to my place and tell me more? Oh, Pulse, I'll ask you another time.
Of course. Thank you, Pulse. See you again.
That's good. Violet may have a useful answer. Oh...
Already gone. I still had something to say...
Ahem. I think I can help.
You don't have to force a decision...
No, this could help the Kingdom of Jude, too.
strings.네? 쥬드 왕국에 대량의 보석이 필요해요? 태양의 궁전에 그렇게 많이 있: Jude needs gems in bulk? There seemed to be so many in the Sun Palace...
As you know, our kingdom suffered greatly in the recent attack.
strings.오랜 시간 굳건하다고 믿었던 나라가 그런 모습이 되면서 주민들은 국가와: Seeing a country they had trusted for so long in that state, the people lost faith in the state and the royal family.
strings.국왕 폐하께서 이 점을 고민하시다가 루맨처럼 주요 거점에 결계를 설치하기: His Majesty considered this and ordered barriers installed at key locations, as in Lumen.
strings.그래서 마법사들이 보석에 마력을 불어넣고 일단 수도부터 결계를 준비했는데: Our mages began imbuing gems with mana to protect the capital first... We hadn't realized just how many gems it would require.
strings.그래서 보석 거래를 할 수 있는 곳을 수소문 중이었어요. 이스트랜드에서는: We've been searching for gem suppliers. We couldn't find a suitable one in Eastland, and now you've brought this good news.
strings.그래서 저희 쥬드 왕국에서 거래하고 싶다고 그분에게 말씀을 전달해주셨으면: Please tell her that Jude would like to trade with her.
strings.그 다음부터는 제가…. 아니, 아버님을 통해서 저희 쪽에서 진행하도록 할: After that, I'll... Rather, we'll proceed through my father.
Not at all. I'm glad I could help. I'll be going.
That expression says you've brought good news.
strings.(쥬빌에게 쥬드 왕국에서 긍정적으로 생각하고 있다고 전한다.): (You tell Jubil that the Kingdom of Jude is interested.)
strings.감사해요. 사실 보석을 판매하기만 하면 되는 거였거든요. 저하고 모험가님: Thank you. All I really needed was to sell the gems. You and I take a commission when the deal is arranged, and that's that.
Hehe. Now I need to build a solid business.
Thank you. I'll tell you when there's more progress.
strings.그런데 왕국과 거래를 할 정도의 많은 양이라면 대체 어디서 구한다는 거죠: But where will you get enough gems to supply a kingdom? I kept wondering that while traveling.
strings.흐음…. 사실 알려드리긴 애매하긴 하지만, 저를 도와주셨으니 그냥 알려드: Hmm... It's difficult to disclose, but since you helped, I'll tell you. Please don't repeat it.
strings.자, 그럼 모험가님을 믿고 말씀드릴게요. 혹시 마법학원 제레니스를 아시나: Then I'll trust you. Have you heard of Xerenis Magic Academy?
I think I've heard the name.
strings.이사장인 클로리스가 어느 순간 학교에 보석이 많아져서 고민 중에 저를 수: Its chairwoman, Chloris, suddenly found the school with an excess of gems. She tracked me down and asked me to handle them.
strings.보석이 어떻게 많아졌는지 궁금하긴 하지만 묻지는 않았어요. 사실 저하고: I'm curious how there came to be so many, but I didn't ask. It isn't my concern. I just need to sell them.
strings.마법학원도 재정이 늘어나서 좋고, 쥬드 왕국은 보석을 가져가서 좋고, 저: The academy gains funds, Jude gets its gems, and you and I earn a commission.
strings.그렇긴 하네요. 그래도 제가 마법학원에 가서 이야기를 들어보고 싶은데 안: It is. Still, could I visit the academy and hear about it myself?
strings.마법학원 제레니스는 허가되지 않은 자가 방문하는 건 금하고 있어서 클로리: Xerenis forbids unauthorized visitors. Even knowing Chloris for so long, I can't arrange that.
strings.게다가 지금 그곳으로 가는 길은 막혀있어요. 가끔 클로리스가 허공해를 통: Besides, the route there is blocked. Chloris sometimes comes through the Void Sea, but I never know when. I have to wait for her.
I understand. It can't be helped.
strings.네, 클로리스에게는 모험가님이 수고해주셨다고 말해둘게요. 하프엘프는 도움: I'll tell Chloris how much you helped. They say half-elves repay kindness twice over, so look forward to it.
strings.클로리스에 대한 이야기는 여기까지. 남 이야기는 길게 하는 게 아니니까요: That's enough about Chloris. We shouldn't talk about others too long.
strings.하여튼, 감사드려요.그럼 다음에도 부탁드릴게요!: Anyway, thank you. I'll count on you again next time!
